payroll_states.scheduled_frozen: schedule_payroll records a batch id, Merkle root, release timestamp, total amount, and frozen=true.
payroll_states.thawed: thaw_payroll requires the release timestamp to have passed before setting frozen=false.
payroll_states.amended: amend_leaf can replace the Merkle root only while the batch remains frozen.
payroll_states.cancelled: cancel_batch emits the cancelled batch id and amount.

sections.transfer_states: The program exposes confidential deposit, transfer, and withdrawal instructions plus reserve deposit and redemption paths.
